cdng_buckner_2000.note: Dedicated Owram review: fresh official full-text HTML, especially numberedparagraphs10–15 (printed9–12) and notes18/19/22. Buckner quotes Owram’s1997 Narrow Circles and1989 Ontario argument, distinguishes his two claims, disputes the specialization/region equation and partial national-law claims, and agrees with the concluding interplay of identities. Both Owram originals remain unread; this is explicit named scholarly mediation, not a new reading of those essays.
